subject: Request: third-party roster + SIG/CAIQ & SOC2 evidence for MedFolio POC
messages:
From: Sarah Green <sarah.green@medfolio.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, MedFolio Procurement <procurement@medfolio.com>
Cc: security@medfolio.com
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 13:05:12 -0700
Subject: Evidence request for POC - subprocessor roster + CAIQ/SOC2

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo today — the team was impressed with the latency profile. Procurement asked me to kick off the security intake so we can move the POC to an internal evaluation. To keep the procurement & security review moving, could you provide the following: 

- Current subprocessor roster (with vendor name, function, country of hosting, and whether KMS is used)
- CAIQ or CAIQ-like checklist (any short attestation is fine for now)
- SOC 2 Type II report (summary or cover letter acceptable)
- KMS/residency note for keys used in hosted API (where master keys are stored)
- Point of contact for follow-up (security engineer / SPM)

Can you confirm what you can share by Wednesday (4/16)? If some items need NDAs or an MDR process, please flag what gating is needed.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Green
Sr. Manager, Vendor Security
MedFolio

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 14:20:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request for POC - subprocessor roster + CAIQ/SOC2

Hi Sarah — appreciate the clear list and the quick timeline.

Quick answers up front: we can share a CSV roster, a SIG/CAIQ-lite attestation, and our SOC 2 Type II cover summary. Marissa (security) will own the attestation and SOC2 follow-up; Ben (customer success) will coordinate delivery and any intake paperwork.

I attached an initial subprocessor roster (redwood_subprocessor_roster_v3.csv) — it includes vendor role, hosting region, and KMS usage column. The roster is redacted for internal contact emails; we can provide more detail under an NDA if needed.

Action plan proposal:
- Today (4/15): I shared the roster (attached) and looped Marissa.
- 4/16: Marissa to share SIG-lite attestation + SOC2 summary.
- 4/18: Deliver full evidence bundle to your secure folder (or via GTM portal) including KMS residency note and link to SOC2 report request form.

Does that timeline work? If you prefer an earlier sync with security, I can set a 30-min call with Marissa and your team tomorrow.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Date: Wed, 16 Apr 2025 09:45:20 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request for POC - subprocessor roster + CAIQ/SOC2

Hi Sarah — I can take point on the evidence pack. Thanks for the clear ask, Connor.

What we'll provide within the timeframe below: 
- SIG/CAIQ-lite attestation (PDF) — includes answers to the control objectives most relevant to hosting + encryption.
- SOC 2 Type II summary (cover letter + scope page) — full report available under executed NDA or secure transfer.
- KMS residency statement: brief note describing master key custody for hosted API (Redwood controls keys using customer-provided KMS for private deployments; hosted customers may use Redwood-managed keys — details included).
- CSV roster (Connor shared) will be augmented with hosting country and data access owners where not sensitive.

Proposed timeline: deliver the SIG-lite and SOC2 summary by end of day Thu 4/17, full evidence and any masked export control items by Fri 4/18. If MedFolio requires the full SOC2 PDF, we'll need a Data Processing Agreement + NDA and an authorized requestor.

Open items for procurement/security: 
1) Can you confirm whether MedFolio has a preferred intake method for SOC2 (DocuSign + secure upload vs. shared drive)?
2) Do you require vendor KMS proofs (key residency screenshots) or is a signed attestation sufficient for POC?

Attaching a short SIG-lite attestation now for immediate review. I'll follow up with SOC2 summary tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@procure.medfolio.com>, MedFolio Procurement <procurement@medfolio.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 09:12:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request for POC - subprocessor roster + CAIQ/SOC2

Marissa / Connor — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the SIG-lite file. Timeline below works for us. Procurement prefers evidence via a secure upload; I've added our procurement lead Tom Ellis on cc. Tom — we typically ask vendors to upload SOC2 PDFs to our secure vendor portal, or provide a signed attestation if portal transfer is not possible.

A couple of clarifications before you finalize: 
- For KMS residency: can you specify whether customer-managed KMS is available for hosted PII/PHI workloads, or if Redwood only supports customer KMS in Private deployments? A sentence or two in the attestation will suffice for our risk team.
- For the subprocessor roster: can you mark which entries are used for inference (model hosting) vs. telemetry/analytics? We want to know data flow boundaries.

If you can confirm those two items in your Friday deliverable, we'll proceed with the POC onboarding next week. Thanks again.

Regards,
Sarah Green
Sr. Manager, Vendor Security | MedFolio
